public.text: The Terminology Service and LIMR are described as components that provide meaning and structure. Semantic interoperability also depends on use-context, provenance, data-capture guidance, implementation guides, mappings, constraints, and workflow interpretation.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the TS and LIMR are core enabling components within a broader semantic-governance ecosystem and do not alone guarantee semantic interoperability.
